CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

What this is

rbcb is an R package that wraps Brazilian Central Bank (BCB) web services: SGS time series, PTAX currency rates (old ptax CSV endpoints and the newer OLINDA OData API), and Focus market expectations (OLINDA OData).

Commands

Run from the repo root in R (or Rscript -e '...'):

devtools::load_all()                       # load package for interactive work
devtools::document()                       # regenerate man/*.Rd and NAMESPACE from roxygen
devtools::test()                           # run all tests
testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-sgs.R")       # one file (after load_all)
devtools::test(filter = "sgs")             # files matching test-*sgs*.R
devtools::check()                          # full R CMD check (what CI runs)
lintr::lint_package()                      # lint, config in .lintr
rmarkdown::render("README.rmd")            # rebuild README.md - edit README.rmd, never README.md
  • NAMESPACE and man/ are generated by roxygen — edit the #' comments in R/, then run document().
  • DESCRIPTION has an explicit Collate: field. A new file in R/ must be added there, or the build fails.
  • Tests hit the live BCB APIs. Network tests use skip_on_cran() + skip_if_offline(); follow that pattern. tests/testthat/setup.R sets options(rbcb_cache = FALSE) for the test run.
  • Bug fixes and user-facing changes go in NEWS.md; bump Version in DESCRIPTION.

Architecture

HTTP layer (R/utils.R). All downloads go through http_download("get"|"post", ...). It hashes the call arguments with digest and writes the response to tempdir()/<hash>, returning the file path. If that file exists and getOption("rbcb_cache", TRUE) is TRUE, the request is skipped. Parsers then read from the file path (fromJSON(f), read_html(f)). rbcb_verbose option turns on httr verbose output. R/rbcb_get_currencies.R has a second, separate in-memory cache (.CACHE_ENV) for the currency list.

SGS series — two APIs on the same code. - Object API: sgs(USD = 1, IPCA = 433) builds an S3 sgs list of sgs_obj (with load_info = TRUE it scrapes series metadata — description, unit, frequency — from the sgspub HTML page). rbcb_get() is an S3 generic (R/rbcb_get.R); rbcb_get.sgs returns one tidy tibble (date, value, name). sgs_untidy() splits it into per-series tibble/xts/ts. - Classic API: get_series() (R/rbcb_get_series.R) is a thin wrapper over the object API. It only loads metadata when as = "ts", because the ts conversion needs the frequency (A/Q/M/D) to set start and frequency in .sgs_convert_split.

Currencies. - R/rbcb_get_currencies.R: legacy ptax endpoints (CSV, Windows-1252 text). get_currency, get_all_currencies, get_currency_cross_rates. The currency list is fetched from the latest available daily file, walking back one day at a time until a file exists. - R/odata_ptax.R: OLINDA PTAX API (olinda_get_currency, olinda_list_currencies). Returns objects of class olinda_df. - R/currency_helpers.R: Bid() / Ask() S3 generics over data.frame, xts and olinda_df. - Type A vs type B quote conventions (currency/USD vs USD/currency) are documented in comments at the top of both currency files.

Market expectations (R/odata-expectativas.R). get_market_expectations(type, ...) is the core; the get_*_market_expectations functions are per-endpoint wrappers. .build_expectations_url builds the OData $filter from indic, start_date, end_date, and merges any extra OData params passed via ... (e.g. $top, $select, a user $filter is AND-ed). Column names come back in Portuguese; keep_names = FALSE maps them to English via change_names.

Other. R/datasets.R queries the dadosabertos CKAN catalog; R/addins.R is an RStudio addin (shiny/miniUI, in Suggests) for searching series.

legacy/ is gitignored scratch (old scripts, and credential files) — not part of the package; don’t read it or add it to the build.

Sibling project

python-bcb (github.com/wilsonfreitas/python-bcb, local clone at ~/dev/python/python-bcb) wraps the same BCB APIs in Python. When a BCB API changes behaviour (date formats, limits, new fields), check the other package too and cross-link the issues (“Mirrors wilsonfreitas/python-bcb#N”). Both repos use the same issue labels (type: *, area: *, priority: *).
